items: COMPLETELY UPGRADED – The upgraded moving tool now features 5 wheels, a reinforced load-bearing steel plate, and enhanced weight limit. The wheels are made of soft rubber material to effectively protect your floors. A single moving dolly can lift 500 pounds, and when four working together, they can handle up to 2000 pounds, which is equivalent to the weight of a small car.

ONE PERSON CAN EASILY MOVE HEAVY ITEMS – By utilizing the leverage principle with a pry bar to lift heavy objects and then securing them underneath using 4 moving dollies for transportation, you can save up to 90% of your effort. This method is particularly useful for moving heavy, large, and oversized items like furniture, sofas, refrigerators, safes, pianos, and equipment when tackling cleaning, renovation, or home decoration projects on your own.

REDUCE THE LIKELIHOOD OF INJURY – Utilize the heavy duty furniture lifter to assist you in moving more efficiently. As you age, it is important to prioritize your health and reduce the risk of injury from manually lifting heavy items. Work together with your spouse to handle the lifting, eliminating the need for additional assistance.

ROBUST STRUCTURAL DESIGN, DURABLE CONSTRUCTION – The innovative layout of five omnidirectional wheels, including a central wheel for even weight distribution, significantly enhances the load-bearing capability. Each wheel features double-layer bearings, ensuring enhanced flexibility on various surfaces. An L-shaped fixed edge is incorporated to prevent slippage during the moving process. Additionally, each moving dolly is equipped with two wheels that have brakes, enabling effortless position locking when needed.
INSIDE THE BOX – You will find the Upgraded Panel Furniture Dolly Set, which includes 4 moving dollies, each measuring 6.9" x 6.9", 1 pry bar, 4 heightening spacers, and 1 pair of work gloves
